annotations.title: Read one part of a session

description: Author role: the conversation of ONE context, by id — every turn in the blocks it occupies, and nothing else. This is what the index is for: match a question against the labels from get_contexts, then read the two or three contexts that fit, rather than re-reading the whole session for every question. Paged like get_spine: follow `next_cursor` until there is none.

context_id.description: A context id from get_contexts, e.g. C3.

run_id.description: Pass your run_id so the reviewer can tell you are still working. Without it a long read looks exactly like you having returned.

name: read_context
title: Read one part of a session
